comment: What tools/android downloads from the GitHub release when it is not on this PC. The Android pack (made with tools/dev/build_android_pack.ps1): build_game.ps1, when <root>/_prepare/android-pack is missing. The app (tools/android/build_apk.ps1, _android/tsukihime.apk): android_port.ps1 -InstallApp, when _android/tsukihime.apk is missing; apk_version is its versionName (build_apk.ps1 -Version). Empty url: nothing published yet.
